info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 以工程師的觀點探討各種機械製造程序有關之材料選擇，力學分析及製程決定等問題，內容包括塑膠成型、工具機加工、非傳統切削、積體電路製造、微奈米製造等技術。
description.describe_eh: To investigate the selection of material , mechanics analysis , selection of manufacturing process from the view point of an engineer. Course content includes plastic molding, machine tools, non-traditional cutting, integrated circuit manufacturing, micro-nano manufacturing and other technologies.
description.pre_subname: ENGS2001材料力學(一)、ENGS2002材料力學(二)
description.pre_sub_ename: ENGS2001 MECHANICS OF MATERIALS(1)、ENGS2002 MECHANICS OF MATERIALS(2)

targets.describe_ch: 能理解機械製造在工業的重要性及影響。
targets.describe_en: Be able to comprehend the importance and effects of manufacturing process to industry.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解機械製造的場合，並能清楚表達。
targets.describe_en: Be able to comprehend manufacturing process principles and make clear statement.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用機械製造的原理，分析一零件或產品，並提出可行驗證方法。
targets.describe_en: Apply principles of manufacturing process to analyze a part or product and propose a feasible method for validation.
